title: Jubilant Crispy British Baby Plum Tomatoes Skewers
description: A festive British dish featuring crispy fried baby plum tomatoes, served in a cazuela, perfect for a snack or light meal. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly recipe combines grassy and aerated elements for a delightful experience.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate dish, beat the eggs until well combined.
Dip each tomato half into the flour mixture, then the eggs, and finally the flour mixture again, coating evenly.
Carefully place the coated tomato halves into the hot oil and fry until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried tomatoes from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Thread 2-3 fried tomato halves onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each tomato.
Drizzle the melted butter over the tomato skewers and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the crispy tomato skewers in a cazuela with a side of lemon wedges.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
